title: Kuwait and Bahrain report intercepting hostile drones as Iran and US trade attacks on Qeshm and Bahrain
detail: Al Jazeera reports Kuwait and Bahrain said they intercepted hostile drone attacks as Iran and the US traded attacks involving Qeshm island and Bahrain. Details are as reported; attribution of each strike is not independently verified here.

title: Trump's Navy secretary nominee acknowledges Iran war is straining US military resources
detail: The nominee for Navy secretary acknowledged that the Iran war is straining US military resources, per Google News aggregation of the report.

title: Amnesty International says Iran used the war as a pretext to intensify repression
detail: Le Monde reports Amnesty International's assertion that Iran used the war in the Middle East as a pretext to intensify domestic repression.
